summary: Expose the live-verified per-item package-size update and persist it in the local cache.
reason: AnyList accepts package-size changes through the set-list-item-package-size protobuf handler when the complete current ListItem is supplied. Preserve that request shape, verify the package size by live item ID before syncing, and migrate existing caches with a JSON-backed package_size column so offline reads do not lose the metadata.
validated_outcome: Added migration-safe package_size persistence, package-size JSON/list output, full-item protobuf request coverage, and read-after-write verification. A disposable live marker item round-tripped package size through set-list-item-package-size and was deleted with its marker list; focused and full Go tests passed, with no production data changed.
